newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Air to raise fares soon - paper.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Air to raise fares soon - paper.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) will raise fares soon following a rise in fuel prices, the Straits Times newspaper reported Wednesday.
An SIA spokesman was quoted as saying the move would be in line with other carriers, which have been burdened by increases in fuel prices, but that further details could not be provided at this time.
The spokesman said the airline's fuel costs increased by 22 percent during the first half of its current financial year, which begins in April.
The International Air Transport Association recently proposed a global 3 percent passenger fare hike to offset rises in operating costs.
The SIA spokesman was not immediately available for comment on the report.
